pr.title: GE-4378: Reconcile outbound transactions with sell deal tranches
pr.head: cc49bfaff72d9058f7ecbe516877e314f9d5f111
pr.author: federicosandrelli
pr.body:
GE-4378 adds a third way to recognise outbound transactions: reconcile them directly against sell deal tranches, with no allocation made first. [#5598](https://github.com/granular-energy/granular-community-back/pull/5598) added the endpoint with a stub that returns 501, and [#5660](https://github.com/granular-energy/granular-community-back/pull/5660) moved the deal matching that both deal sides share into one module. This PR is the second step of the [plan](https://github.com/granular-energy/granular-community-back/blob/6e81879/.claude/plans/20260929-ge4378-outbound-sell-deal-reconciliation.md), replaces the stub, and removes the plan now that the implementation is in. It supersedes [#5694](https://github.com/granular-energy/granular-community-back/pull/5694) with the same commits on a new branch; the review threads there are resolved in the current head.

## Changes
* The service writes the records a user gets by recognising, allocating to the tranche, and finalising the batch.
* Undo, delivery monitoring, and the consistency checks are unchanged from the buy side.
* Each dispatched supply volume goes to the demand volume of its month, in the organisation time zone.
* Matching and tranche capacity follow the buy side rules as is. With over-delivery, the excess goes to the last selected tranche. Without it, the excess stays recognised against no demand, and an operation where no tranche can take anything fails with a message.
* New checks reject a buy tranche, a tranche with any allocation, a selected volume that is already recognised, and a selected volume that matches none of the selected tranches.
* The transaction volume query now loads the asset, which the matcher reads during the request.
